description: List the objects under each layer for a spread, as the Layers panel shows them when a layer is expanded, or rename, show, hide, lock or unlock individual objects there

action.description: List the objects, or change the given items

layer.description: For list: only this layer (default: every layer)

locked.description: For update: lock or unlock the items

name.description: For update: new name (one item only)

spreadIndex.description: For list: the spread (default: the active spread)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

visible.description: For update: show or hide the items

name: manage_layer_objects
title: Manage Layer Objects
